Changes: Java, sequential bounded requests, stable numeric IDs, explicit failures,
word timing validation, source translations, and stable-ID binding enrichment.
QRC decryption uses QQ's non-standard DES variant and zlib, not standard JCE DES.
The upstream credits WXRIW/Lyricify-Lyrics-Helper (Apache-2.0) for request
parameters and format/crypto implementations.
https://github.com/WXRIW/Lyricify-Lyrics-Helper
No Spotify, notification, account, machine-translation, or upstream UI code is included.

https://github.com/amll-dev/applemusic-like-lyrics
The local renderer bundles AMLL and its runtime dependencies. Full notices are
included in AMLL-NOTICES.txt. The only upstream change is the manual-scroll
resume delay (500 ms -> 3000 ms); see demo/build.mjs for the reproducible patch.
